author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video to discover how Fuse Games used UE5’s Lumen, Nanite, and World Partition to create striking visuals that do justice to the innovative gameplay and worldbuilding of ‘ _Star Wars_ : Galactic Racer™’.

‘ _Star Wars_ : Galactic Racer™’ blends high-speed racing with a roguelite twist. You play a driver in the galaxy’s renegade racing circuit, taking speeder bikes, skim speeders, and landspeeders for a spin as you make a bid to climb the ranks and take pole position. 

Developer Fuse Games pulled a masterstroke by adding a roguelite loop that enables you to plot your own path across the planets, choosing branching routes and tackling time trials, elimination events, and lap races while customizing your character and upgrading your vehicle with gameplay-altering abilities.

Read our full interview with the team to discover how Lumen, Nanite, and World Partition freed them up from building core technology so they could focus on delivering high-quality visuals worthy of a gala
